//: A dated, reproducible absence check for the three sequences staged in this directory. Written by oversight/oeis/pollard-rho-x2plus1 on 2026-07-27. Method: ask oeis.org for each staged prefix and record the exact URL and the exact answer. anums null means no catalogued sequence begins with those terms in that order; a non-empty list would be a prompt for a human to look, never an automatic verdict. The two controls exist because a quietly broken harness returns null for everything, which is the answer we are hoping for.

queries.description: periodic points of x^2+1 mod n, a(1..20)
Sum_{c=0..n-1} periodic points of x^2+c mod n, a(1..16)
Sum_{c=0..n-1} cycles of x^2+c mod n, a(1..16)

summary: Controls behaved: the positive control returned A000142 and the negative control returned nothing, so the nulls below are informative. All three staged prefixes returned no catalogued match.
